As discussed, we think a short executive-level demo (20–30 minutes) that focuses on production economics and reliability would be useful to get leadership alignment and next steps. It would be great to have your CIO (or their delegate) join so we can cover architecture, security posture, and a top-level SLA overview.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed 18 Mar, 10:00–10:30am

If none of those work, please suggest two alternatives and I’ll coordinate on our side. We’ll plan to keep it tight: 10–15 mins of exec-level context + 10–15 mins for Q&A. I’ll bring Jonas (solutions engineering) and Marissa (account lead).

I’ve attached a short exec deck and a one-pager so you have context.

Best,
